sources.title: Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the exact instruction-tuned checkpoint card still reports 90B (88.8) in its Params table for Llama 3.2-Vision, with text/image input and text output. This is Meta's published nominal complete-model count; the card provides no separate active-parameter count.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 release announcement
sources.evidence: September 25, 2024 announcement releases both pretrained and instruction-tuned 11B/90B vision models with downloadable weights; describes the vision encoder and cross-attention adapter added to the language model.

sources.title: Official exact model architecture registry
sources.evidence: The Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct entry specifies 80 language layers, width 8192, 64 attention heads, 8 KV heads and 20 vision cross-attention layers, with 560-pixel image tiles.

sources.title: Official Llama model families and context limits
sources.evidence: Maps the exact 90B Vision Instruct identifier to Llama 3.2; max_seq_length returns 131072 for its default BF16 format. The 8192 exception concerns int4 models.

sources.title: Official Llama multimodal Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Implements dense vision and language Transformer blocks, a vision projection, and dense gated cross-attention blocks with SwiGLU feed-forward layers; the model registry determines the exact layer counts.

sources.title: Official Llama 3.2 Vision prompt and tool format
sources.evidence: Documents built-in and zero-shot tool calling using the Llama 3.1 format with text-only inputs, and explicitly states tool calling does not work with images in the prompt.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Custom license dated September 25, 2024 grants conditioned use and redistribution of weights, incorporates the acceptable-use policy, and imposes additional terms above 700 million monthly active users.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Acceptable Use Policy
sources.evidence: For the multimodal models, the license grant excludes EU-domiciled individuals and companies whose principal place of business is in the EU; the exception covers end users of incorporating products or services.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. No access gate was bypassed and no weight shards were downloaded; public Meta registry and implementation supply architecture/context evidence.

sources.title: Official Llama 3.2 Vision model card, fresh parameter check
sources.evidence: The vision-specific card explicitly covers pretrained and instruction-tuned models, lists the 90B (88.8) parameter row, and describes a Llama 3.1 language model augmented with an image encoder and cross-attention adapter. It does not disclose an active count.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Table 3 active-count comparison
sources.evidence: Table 3 explicitly labels active parameters as LLM+VT but identifies Llama3.2-11B-Inst., not the 90B model. Its 8B+2.6B convention cannot be transferred to the unlisted 90B checkpoint.

sources.title: DeepSeek-VL2 Technical Report, activated-parameter plot and comparisons
sources.evidence: Figure 1 explicitly plots activated parameters for small vision-language models, but does not include Llama 3.2 90B. The original SVG was visually inspected. Its active-count convention therefore does not establish the requested exact model.

sources.title: InternVL3 Technical Report, Figure 2 model-size comparison
sources.evidence: Figure 2 includes Llama-3.2-90B-Vision, but the visually inspected horizontal axis is Parameters (B), not active or activated parameters. It corroborates the nominal size tier without resolving active count.

sources.title: InternVL3.5 Technical Report, fresh comparison search
sources.evidence: The report includes a Llama-3.2-90B-Vision SVG benchmark row. Its explicit activated-parameter convention accompanies its own InternVL3.5 model architecture table; no active count for the Llama 90B comparator was found in the report or inspected introductory chart.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report, fresh comparison search
sources.evidence: Inspected architecture and benchmark tables for a missed Llama 3.2 90B active-count comparison. The report does not supply a separate active count for the target checkpoint.

sources.title: GLM-4.1V-Thinking and GLM-4.5V Technical Report, fresh comparison search
sources.publisher: GLM-V Team, Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: The report explicitly states active parameters for GLM-4.5V itself, but its text and inspected introductory comparison chart do not provide a Llama 3.2 90B active count.

developer.note: Developer identified by the official card and announcement.

family.note: The exact model belongs to Llama 3.2 within the catalog’s broader Llama family.

release_date.note: Original public release includes the instruction-tuned 90B vision variant; day precision is explicit.

open_weights.note: Downloadable weights under a custom license and access conditions; this does not imply an unrestricted open-source license.

license.note: Custom license incorporating the AUP. Multimodal license rights exclude EU-domiciled individuals and EU-principal-place-of-business companies, with an exception for end users of incorporating products/services.

parameters_b.note: Freshly reconfirmed Meta nominal complete-model specification: 90B tier, with 88.8B parenthetical precision. Retained as published; no tensor-exact census is required. The model includes language, vision and adapter components.

active_parameters_b.note: Meta does not separately report active parameters. Fresh original comparison checks did not establish an active count for this exact 90B checkpoint: Kimi-VL labels active parameters only for the 11B sibling, while InternVL3 labels the 90B plot axis only Parameters. Neither the 70B language backbone, dense topology nor the total establishes the whole-model active count; no phase values are inferred.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive language Transformer with a vision encoder/projection and cross-attention adapter. Exact 90B Instruct registry: 80 language layers plus 20 cross-attention layers, width 8192, 64 query heads and 8 KV heads.

context_window.note: The exact model maps to the non-int4 Llama 3.2 registry limit of 131072 tokens; this resolves the card’s abbreviated 128k.

modalities.note: Text-only and text-plus-image prompts generate text.

reasoning.note: Visual reasoning and CoT benchmark results do not establish a dedicated reasoning/thinking mode; none is documented in the inspected card or prompt specification.

tool_call.note: Native built-in and zero-shot tool-call formats are documented for text-only prompts. Meta explicitly excludes prompts containing images.

description.value: Instruction-tuned dense vision-language model with 88.8B reported parameters, supporting visual question answering, document understanding, captioning, and text chat.
description.note: Replaces the vague large/open wording with supported model size, dense architecture, instruction tuning and intended tasks.

patch.description: Instruction-tuned dense vision-language model with 88.8B reported parameters, supporting visual question answering, document understanding, captioning, and text chat.

patch.notes: Meta reports nominal 88.8B complete multimodal parameters (90B tier); a separate active count remains undisclosed. Architecture combines 80 language Transformer layers with 20 vision cross-attention layers. Context is 131072 tokens. Native tool calling applies only to text-only prompts; image prompts are excluded. The custom license incorporates the AUP’s EU multimodal restriction and end-user exception. A dedicated reasoning mode is not separately disclosed.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirms Meta’s nominal 88.8B complete-model total and explicitly retains active_parameters_b=null/undisclosed. Reopened the exact checkpoint card, official vision card and multimodal implementation. Searched exact active-count terms and checked original Kimi-VL, DeepSeek-VL2, Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL3, InternVL3.5 and GLM-V reports. Kimi-VL’s explicit 11B sibling active row cannot establish the 90B count; InternVL3’s 90B plot labels only Parameters. Aggregator active values were not treated as developer disclosures. No tensor census, weight shards, backbone substitution or invented phase counts were used. All 12 unrelated assessments are preserved.
